notes: **2026-09-04** — (worktree `rf-imp-04`, branch `refactor/imp-01-pricing-package`) — **CSP connect-src local-lane fix.** `next.config.mjs`'s `headers()` gated the `connect-src` dev-localhost relaxation on `isDev = NODE_ENV !== "production"`, always `false` in a built image — so the local Docker/E2E lane's browser login was CSP-blocked with no HTTP response, rendered as a bogus credentials error. Fix: extracted the CSP construction into new `apps/web/csp.mjs` (`apiConnectSources(apiUrl)` + `buildContentSecurityPolicy({ isDev, apiUrl })`), driving the http/ws relaxation off the baked `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` instead of `NODE_ENV`; prod output pinned byte-identical in `apps/web/lib/csp.test.ts`. Docs: `apps/web/e2e/LOCAL-LANE.md`. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
